paragraphs: R' Hanina bar Andrei — Berakhot, chapter 1, halakha 1.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The source gives Berakhot chapter 1, halakha 1. Its format suggests Jerusalem Talmud but no supplied named witness verifies that identification.
Hanina’s abbreviated title is retained as R', restoring the older neutral R. rather than the unsupported Rabbi expansion. Andrei remains the supplied name, without identity normalization.
